description.value: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort was established in 1904 and is one of the oldest four-season resorts in BC, situated near Kamloops and Sun Peaks. The resort offers rustic log cabins with wood-burning cook stoves, RV and tent camping, and lake-based activities including fishing and paddling. Access is via 14.6 km of dirt road with a gated entry, and there is no cell service on site.

address.value: 9608 Knouff Lake Road, Heffley Creek, British Columbia V0E 1Z1, Canada
